description: Immutable data class representing interest rate chart slabs, including details like period type, interest rate, incentives, and associated options collections.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing an interest rate chart slab with various attributes and options.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new InterestRateChartSlabData instance with specified core parameters and null/default options collections.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new InterestRateChartSlabData based on an existing instance, replacing options collections with provided ones.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a new InterestRateChartSlabData with all core attributes set to null, serving as a template.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the description of the interest rate chart slab.

methods.name: periodType
methods.description: Returns the period type of the slab.

methods.name: fromPeriod
methods.description: Returns the starting period.

methods.name: toPeriod
methods.description: Returns the ending period.

methods.name: amountRangeFrom
methods.description: Returns the minimum amount range.

methods.name: amountRangeTo
methods.description: Returns the maximum amount range.

methods.name: annualInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the annual interest rate.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Returns the currency data.

methods.name: periodTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of period type options.

methods.name: addIncentives
methods.description: Adds an incentive to the incentives set.

methods.name: incentives
methods.description: Returns the set of incentives.

methods.name: entityTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the entity type options collection.

methods.name: attributeNameOptions
methods.description: Returns the attribute name options collection.

methods.name: conditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the condition type options collection.

methods.name: incentiveTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the incentive type options collection.

methods.name: genderOptions
methods.description: Returns the gender options collection.

methods.name: clientTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the client type options collection.

methods.name: clientClassificationOptions
methods.description: Returns the client classification options collection.
